football_evidence.question: Can Texas’ pass rush get to Kamario Taylor?
football_evidence.assessment: EdgeDesk’s number is 7.8 points closer to Mississippi State than the line, and EdgeDesk cannot account for most of that: its own breakdown accounts for about 0.9 of the 7.8 points. The measured football evidence leans toward Texas, not toward EdgeDesk’s number. Treat the gap as an open research question, not as an edge.

When Texas has the ball (the red zone): Texas’ offense succeeds on 43.1% of its red-zone plays, and Mississippi State’s defense allows success on 33.6% of opponent red-zone plays (FBS average 43.6%).
